boundary: Seed adequacy means the catalog has enough verified cross-domain coverage to switch from bulk seeding to task-driven registration. It does not claim completeness of the global authority universe, task applicability, conformance, certification, authorization, or that deferred sources are unimportant.

deferredResiduals.name: DAMA-DMBOK
deferredResiduals.reason: Broad data-management body of knowledge; no current organizational data-governance workload requires a concrete binding.

deferredResiduals.name: Design Council Double Diamond
deferredResiduals.reason: Product-discovery method reference; register only when a real discovery profile needs stable authority identity.

deferredResiduals.name: SMPTE family
deferredResiduals.reason: A media workload must identify the concrete SMPTE standard/recommended practice rather than registering the entire family as one authority.

deferredResiduals.name: RIPE Atlas
deferredResiduals.reason: Measurement service/provider rather than protocol-semantic authority.

deferredResiduals.name: OpenSSF Scorecard
deferredResiduals.reason: Current local use is as a provider/tool producing risk signals, not as a standards identity.

deferredResiduals.name: Sigstore
deferredResiduals.reason: Ecosystem/provider name is too broad; register a concrete stable specification only when a workload binds it.

deferredResiduals.name: OSF Registrations
deferredResiduals.reason: Registration service/provider; task-local preregistration requirements should bind exact provider/rules when used.

deferredResiduals.name: OpenAlex
deferredResiduals.reason: Scholarly discovery service/provider rather than a cross-task semantic standard.

deferredResiduals.name: Semantic Scholar
deferredResiduals.reason: Scholarly discovery service/provider rather than a cross-task semantic standard.

deferredResiduals.name: CITATION.cff
deferredResiduals.reason: Register its concrete specification when released research software actually uses the format.

deferredResiduals.name: IGDA Game Accessibility guidance
deferredResiduals.reason: Practical guidance should be bound to the exact current guide/resource used by a game workload.

deferredResiduals.name: Steam / Apple App Store / Google Play
deferredResiduals.reason: Destination-specific rolling platform rules belong to the exact distribution/release workload rather than a static global bundle.

deferredResiduals.name: CVSS / CWE / CVE Record Format / ATT&CK / CIS Controls / OWASP SAMM
deferredResiduals.reason: High-value security authorities, but the active Security package does not currently bind them to a real workload. Register the exact authority/version when a Security task does.

growthTriggers: active task/profile/package names an unresolved external authority
exact edition/version/currentness affects verification or delivery
repeated cross-domain reuse justifies Level-0 discovery
registered authority changes lifecycle state or a new edition must be represented
